_about: The one spelling of a Vobiz media-stream token the engine accepts (src/stream_tokens.py). The web app mints it in src/lib/vobiz/tokens.ts; sahayakai-main/src/__tests__/scripts/voice-engine-contract.test.ts mints one with the real mintVobizToken and checks it against these patterns on every pull request, and tests/test_stream_token_canonical.py checks the engine's own patterns equal these.
